description:
You are designing the layout for the Community Garden Spring Newsletter. The 'Letter from the President' is currently a standard text block at the top of Page 1, but it needs to be moved into a layout that spans two pages. 

1. Create a text frame on the right side of Page 1.
2. Create a second text frame on Page 2.
3. Link the first frame to the second frame so text flows automatically between them.
4. Move the entire 'Letter from the President' story (heading and body text) into the first frame.
5. Ensure the text flows from the Page 1 frame into the Page 2 frame.
6. Save the final document as '/home/ga/Documents/newsletter_final.odt'.

Do not rely on manual copy-pasting to split the text; the frames must be professionally linked.

metadata.target_story_content_fragment: As we welcome the first green shoots of spring
